detected_language.description: BCP-47 code of the language the original letter was written in, e.g., 'de' for German.

sender.description: Who sent the letter (organization or authority name). Use `null` if unknown.

letter_type.description: Short category, e.g., 'tax notice', 'eviction warning', 'promotional offer'. Use `null` if unknown.

requires_action.description: Whether the recipient must take action in response to this letter.

summary.description: 1-3 sentence plain-language explanation of what the letter is and why it was sent, written in the reader's chosen language.

date.description: Absolute date in YYYY-MM-DD format if the letter states one; `null` if the deadline is relative or absent.

raw_text.description: The letter's exact wording for the deadline, e.g., 'within 14 days of receipt'.

is_relative_to_receipt.description: True if the deadline is counted from when the reader receives the letter; false if it's a fixed date.

action.description: The action the recipient must take, written in the target language.

required_actions.description: List of actions the recipient must take. Empty array if no action is required.

consequences_if_missed.description: What the letter explicitly states will happen if no action is taken; `null` if not stated.
